why_this_addendum_exists: EVALUATION_MANIFEST.json pre-registered fork_join, asymmetric_depth_join, local_quorum and nested_branch as held out. While building the substrate those four structures were executed as probes, and two substrate defects were found and fixed as a direct result (a demand arriving before its upstreams differentiate was permanently consumed; a differentiated cell dropped a fresh demand instead of re-inducing downstream). The substrate was therefore developed WITH SIGHT of those structures. Their hold-out is spent. They are demoted to development here rather than reported as independent qualification. This is the same correction Phase 3C applied when PR #59's Gate F was found not to be structurally held out; the response to a broken hold-out is to say so and construct a real one.

genuinely_held_out_structures.diamond_reconverge: two independent joins whose outputs reconverge at a third join
genuinely_held_out_structures.cross_family_join: a join whose arms must be supplied by DIFFERENT capability families
genuinely_held_out_structures.deep_chain_join: a depth-4 serial chain feeding one arm of a join
genuinely_held_out_structures.dual_quorum_series: two quorum cells in series, the second consuming the first
genuinely_held_out_structures.partitioned_nested_branch: nested branch with a partition inside the nested arm
genuinely_held_out_structures.combined_causal_failure: partition and asymmetric starvation and capability loss in one episode

holdout_integrity_statement: None of the six structures above has been executed at any point before this commit. No probe, no test, no runner. The substrate is frozen at commit substrate/v2.py as of the implementation commit that precedes this one; if any of these structures fails, the failure is reported and the substrate is NOT tuned to make it pass.
pre_registration_method: Git ancestry. Committed alone, before verification/phase3d/run_phase3d.py and before any results file exists. scripts/ci/check_phase3d_preregistration.py enforces both manifests.
